notes.title: Curve Games Publisher sale 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

FOR THE KING II

We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

SPACE CREW

Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for FREE and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends March 13th!
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


WOBBLY LIFE

We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on GeForce Now!

What GeForce Now is:[

GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

What else is going on?

We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is coming soon! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

Discover a host of fresh features, fearsome enemies and devilish dungeons across brand new epic campaigns.  Wishlist the game now and embark on a quest like no other. notes.title: Patch Notes Version: 1.1.13
notes.content: Fixes a progress blocker in the Space Ship level of Iron Fish mode

notes.title: Patch Notes Version: 1.1.12
notes.content: Fixed 'You Are Fish!' Achievement not unlocking correctly and added a check on start up to award the Achievement if all other Achievements have been unlocked.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version: 1.1.11
notes.content:
Added a brief timer after the piranha attaches to an object where the bite can't be deactivated accidentally by rapidly pressing the ability button
 Adjusted Nigel's repathing timer when repathing after losing sight of the fish and adjusted paths in the corridor area so Nigel won't trap the player in rooms
 Added temporary barriers to prevent the fish from being thrown out of the suitcase when transitioning to the plane in Flying Fish Level 3
 Fixed colliders on the top of the escalator in Flying Fish Level 3 so that the fish can't be thrown out of the bucket when hitting the sides with the corner of the bucket
 Regrettably stopped Greg's head from disappearing when respawning in Iron Fish mode in the Aquarium level
 Fixed issue where the last minecart in Flying Fish level 2 would empty itself if jumped in prior to it hitting the last gate
 Added water volumes to burst water pipes in Flying Fish 2 so that suffocation timer is reset when entering the water stream
 Adjusted trajectory of a burst pipe stream in Flying Fish level 2 to more consistently hit a warning sign that triggers a flood as it was previously easy to miss if entering the stream from certain angles
 Removed menu option to skip checkpoint in Iron Fish mode after dying
 Fixed achievement for all achievements being unlocked not unlocking and adding check on start up to award the achievement if all achievements have been unlocked
 Reverted suitcases resetting on the first suitcase belt on respawn, now only resets suitcases that have flipped off the belt with a fish inside
 Fixed various places where PlayStation controller buttons were missing in the UI
 Changed Curve Digital to Curve Games
 Replaced numbers in Aquarium and Space levels with dpad icons when using a controller to fix corrupted text issue and more accurately show controls
 Fix for light gates in the Aquarium level getting stuck when dropped from a height
 Removed shallow water area by big tank Greg in the Aquarium
 Fix for fade to black on death in the Aquarium
 Fix for point in Flying Fish level 1 where the fish can get stuck
 Fix for blue crate in the market of Flying Fish level 1 that could repel the bucket at great force if hit with a corner of the bucket
 Prevented fish from being bounced when landing under the trampoline in Goldfish level 2
 Fix for scrollbar not appearing in the game settings
 Fix for selection bar on "Invert Flight controls" not aligning correctly in Russian
 Added collision to planks with missing collision in Puffer level 2
 Expanded water volume to cover behind first valve in the Space level
 Fixed colliders in the office section of Flying Fish level 3 to prevent getting stuck under the lamp and to more accurately match the dividers
 Added colliders prevent getting stuck on the ladder in Goldfish level 2
 Fix for incorrect achievements being unlocked by the criteria for other achievements

notes.title: Patch Notes Version: 1.1.8
notes.content:
Fixes an issue in the Flying Fish airport level where suitcases may float above the conveyer belt.

Also fixes an issue where Iron Fish achievements were not unlocking correctly.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version: 1.1.7
notes.content:
Fix for controllers not responding on Xbox Series/Xbox One
 Also fixes a related suitcase respawn bug where suitcases wouldn't revert position on a particular belt.
 Fixed suitcases on flying fish level 3 blocking the level by not resetting
 Fixed collider on trolley in flying fish level 3 where the fishbowl could get stuck
 Fix for game unpausing when returning from constrained when the pause menu is open on Xbox Series/Xbox One
 Made it clearer that controller is required when attempting to auto switch to normal controls after controller is disconnected
 Removed NaN Compatibility option from video settings
 Added inverted Y controls for flying fish
 Fixed visual issue on water near bucket in Flying Fish level 2
 Made radiators near bread have smaller radius
 Fixed a pain point and made suitcases easier to move in Flying Fish level 3
 Calmed motorway cars down
 On Aquarium level moved puffer gate to other side, spawn fish in bucket at first escalator, added extra pipes to piranha tank
 Calmed seagulls down on puffer fish level 2
 Connected a missing checkpoint from the left route on puffer fish level 1
 Added a more common bucket to checkpoint, so 2 don't appear frequently before getting swallowed by Greg on puffer fish level 3
 Made the seagulls far more chill on Piranha level 1
 Fixed suffocation time that was 15 seconds on Gold fish level 3
 Fix for controllers not being usable by the player when multiple controllers or keyboards that emulate controllers are connected on PC
 Fixed not being able to open the pause menu on Bossa controls via the keyboard when the controllers are disconnected, making the game appear to be unresponsive
 Fix for normal controls message not allowing the user to press "No" to switching to normal controls.
 Fix for occasionally corrupted fish bowl shadow on Gold fish 1
 Lowered the High fog quality performance budget 
 Balancing adjustments to Flying 3
 Balancing adjustments to Puffer 3
 Fixed transition from airport to airplane
 Fixed respawning while in suitcases

notes.title: Patch Notes Version: 1.1.5
notes.content:
Added an invert camera option to the game settings
 Fixes for shell initialised 0 error on Steam
 Fix for black screen/particles issue affecting non-Nvidia players
 Fixes for save data being lost when changing username
 Fix for slowdown effects persisting and affecting performance after restarting levels mid effect
 Fix for game starting on the wrong monitor after changing the monitor in the settings.
 Added font switcher to subtitle prefab to fix missing JA/KO/RU/ZH-CN/ZH-TW dialogue subtitles
 Fix for suitcases not spawning when skipping checkpoints and also when the checkpoint is missed
 Fixes for bug when inside a suitcase during death and respawn/next checkpoint would fail
 Fixed softlock on Space level where skipping checkpoint prevented door from being opened by Piranha
 Prevented graphics settings from being cloud saved on steam
 Pause game when steam overlay is activated and unpauses when deactivated (if the pause menu wasn't already open on activation)
 Prevented the pufferfish causing damage when colliding with the inside of Greg's stomach causing rapid increase in vomit when entering Greg while puffed.
 Fixes for connection/disconnection events not firing in menus when the controller isn't interacted with
 Fix for issue where NPC fish entering the pipes forces the player back through the pipes
 Added missing localisation on special ability tutorial prompt
 Added a confirmation message when switching to Bossa or Normal controls to prevent accidently switching control schemes
 Switched around order of Yes/No on confirmation panels

notes.title: I Am Fish Snap Camera and Snapchat AR lenses available now!
notes.content:
From today I Am Fish fans can share their love for our aquatic allies by downloading the I Am Fish Snap Camera Lens for Windows and Mac desktops or the I Am Fish Snapchat AR Lens for Android and iOS.
The I Am Fish Snap Camera Lens for Windows and Mac immerses you in an underwater world with four different filters to choose from, each heroing a different fishy champion from the I Am Fish cast. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617903/5019387a70d45c975456d68728c9b81eaec4ab16.gif

The I Am Fish Snap Camera Lens is compatible with OBS Studio, Steamlabs OBS and XSplit Broadcaster – the most popular streaming tools for Twitch, perfect for projecting an aquatic atmosphere, whether playing I Am Fish at launch on 16th September, or giving your current favourite games a fishy-twist. 
Insert Snap Camera infographic

To download Snap Camera simply head on over to https://snapcamera.snapchat.com/ and paste the following URL into the search bar: https://www.snapchat.com/unlock/?type=SNAPCODE&uuid=ac0d8b83111449a5a1365ed4e1732328&metadata=01  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617903/a3dbe4aee9e420f535ae91ac1fe415b7c676eebd.jpg

If Snapchat is more your thing, use the I Am Fish Snapchat AR Lens for Android and iOS to get up close and personal with Goldfish, Pufferfish, Flying Fish and Piranha and share your favourite moments with friends on Snapchat, Instagram, TikTok and Twitter. To access the Lens simply search for “I Am Fish” within the Snapchat app. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40617903/fb33314705119b5df13337719daf18fcd30328c8.jpg

Insert Snapchat infographic

The I Am Fish Snap Camera and Snapchat AR lenses feature branding from our good friends at Whale and Dolphin Conservation. WDC is a UK -registered charity (no. 1014705) and is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. With a vision of a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free, WDC fights for the survival of these beautiful creatures by ending captivity, stopping whaling, preventing deaths in nets, and creating healthy seas. A donation from the sale of each copy of I Am Fish sold on Steam will go directly to WDC.

You can stay up to date with all things I Am Fish by following:

 YouTube
 Twitter
 Discord

notes.title: I AM FISH SCREENSHOT CHALLENGE
notes.content:
Win a £100 Steam Digital Gift Card!

Do you have what it takes to reunite four intrepid fish friends in the brand new, physics-based adventure: I Am Fish?

Get a taste of the aquatic action and a chance to win one of three £100 Steam Digital Gift Cards by taking the Steam demo for a dip.

No need to be a bass-tro-physicist or brain sturgeon – Simply follow the three steps via the links at the bottom of competition page.

1.	Follow I Am Fish on Twitter - https://twitter.com/IAmFishGame
2.	Wishlist I Am Fish on Steam - https://bit.ly/3igTKC9  
3.	Upload a Screenshot from the demo via the link on the competition page

We’re challenging you to put your clam-era skills to the test by snapping a creative screenshot! Whether it’s a near miss, a gruesome fish death, a scenic view or a legendary completion time – we want to see what you can come up with! Share your screenshot on Twitter and tag @IAmFishGame to show off your creative endeavours.  

You have until 11pm BST on 31st July to enter. 

Once you’ve finished the demo why not try to improve your performance and star rating? Aim for a quick time and avoid dying to unlock the elusive 5 stars! 

The demo now also comes with a digital artbook and wallpaper for your desktop. 

The competition is subject to our Ts&Cs. 

Check out the O-FISH-AL Announcement trailer here
